note: Quiet, relatively primitive campground ~8,800 ft, 4 mi up FSR 501 from the Frying Pan River Road, past Ruedi Reservoir (24 mi east of Basalt). The loop sits just below the road above a willow meadow with a meandering stream. --Claude
summary: FS campground page + White River NF 2026 operating-dates sheet: confirmed 7 sites, first-come only, no potable water, $20. Added max site length 30 ft, season 05-13..10-02 (2026 estimate), no hookups. Website is the forest home page: own FS page given. Phone missing: Aspen-Sopris RD (970) 963-2266. Note trimmed (dropped the restated facts and the unsupported 'South Fork Fryingpan').
flags: CRITERIA (rig-length wording): the campground page singles this one out - 'Camping units for autos, pickup campers, tents, and small trailers' - wording not found on the neighbouring Aspen-Sopris pages checked (Dearhamer and Little Mattie: 'suitable for tents, trailers, and RVs'). The same forest's 2026 operating-dates sheet states a 30-ft maximum site length for Elk Wallow, which outranks the wording, so a 23-ft rig should fit.
Website is the White River NF home page; the campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/elk-wallow-campground.
Missing phone: Aspen-Sopris Ranger District (970) 963-2266 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/offices); the campground page shows only the supervisor's office, 970 945-2521.

Toilet conflict on the FS page: the description says 'One vault type toilet' while the amenity block says 'Restrooms are not available at this site'. Kept vault_toilets true on the specific statement.

Road: the FS page gives no condition or RV advice for FSR 501 (4 miles from the Frying Pan Road) and the forest alerts list nothing for it; Ruedi-area alerts (no well water at the Ruedi Reservoir campgrounds; Little Maud and Mollie B closed for the season) do not name Elk Wallow.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront): no per-site coordinates. On imagery the small loop sits just south of FSR 501 with a meandering stream ~40-60 m away across a willow meadow; the FS page mentions fishing ('North Fork Mormon Creek'). Possible creekside lead if sites reach the bank; not changed.
Note: the stored note placed the campground on the 'South Fork Fryingpan'; no FS page says so (dropped).
